## mentionkit-skill v0.1.1 Changelog

- Added new documentation files: README.md, references, and detailed API/MCP docs.
- Added a skills.sh.json file for shell integration.
- Removed redundant skill-card.md file.
- No changes to core workflow, API usage, or supported features.  
- Improved documentation and references for users and developers.

Initial release of Mentionkit skill.

- Query and manage Mentionkit social monitoring workflows.
- Supports both Mentionkit MCP (preferred for agent workflows) and Public API v1 (for scripting and basic data access).
- Allows reviewing brand mentions, finding reply opportunities, shortlisting leads, inspecting source links, and creating tracked keywords (MCP only).
- Enforces workflow rules for MCP-based review and curation.
- Clearly distinguishes when to use MCP vs. API v1 based on capabilities and environment.
